حَجّ

Hajj, day by day from Makkah to Arafah and back

Five days, four places and eight rites, each shown as a moving diagram with the words to say, so you can see the whole pilgrimage before you begin it.

Begin the journey

Before you begin: choose your type of Hajj

Tamattu'

Most common for pilgrims from abroad

Perform Umrah first and leave ihram, then enter ihram again for Hajj on the 8th. A sacrifice is required.

See the Umrah guide

Qiran

Enter ihram for Umrah and Hajj together and stay in ihram until the 10th. A sacrifice is required. The sa'i done after the arrival tawaf counts for Hajj.

Ifrad

Enter ihram for Hajj only and stay in ihram until the 10th. No sacrifice is required. Like Qiran, sa'i may be done after the arrival tawaf.

The steps below follow Tamattu'. Where Qiran or Ifrad differ, it is noted.

    Prefer less motion?

    Ihram and the day in Mina

    8 Dhul Hijjah, the Day of Tarwiyah

    • In the morning, wherever you are staying in Makkah, bathe, wear ihram clothing and make your intention for Hajj. Qiran and Ifrad pilgrims are already in ihram.
    • The same rules apply as in Umrah: no perfume, cutting hair or nails, hunting or marital relations; men do not cover the head or wear stitched clothing; women do not wear niqab or gloves.
    • Go to Mina, reciting the talbiyah often.
    • Pray Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha and the next Fajr in Mina, each at its own time. Dhuhr, Asr and Isha are shortened to two rak'ahs.

    لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ حَجًّا

    Here I am, O Allah, for Hajj. Your intention.

    لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ

    The talbiyah, recited until you throw at Jamrat al-Aqabah on the 10th.

    The standing at Arafah

    9 Dhul Hijjah, from midday until sunset

    Hajj is Arafah. Being anywhere within its boundaries during this time is the one rite that, if missed, means Hajj is missed. Check the boundary signs; Masjid Namirah is partly outside it.

    • Leave Mina after sunrise.
    • At Dhuhr time, pray Dhuhr and Asr together, both shortened to two rak'ahs, with one adhan and two iqamahs.
    • Spend the rest of the day facing the qibla in du'a, dhikr, Qur'an and repentance, raising your hands. You do not need to climb Jabal al-Rahmah or see it.
    • Stay until sunset, then leave calmly. Do not pray Maghrib in Arafah.

    لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

    The Prophet ﷺ said this is the best of what he and the prophets before him said on the day of Arafah.

    The night in Muzdalifah

    Night between the 9th and 10th, under the open sky

    • On arrival, pray Maghrib and Isha together, with Isha shortened to two rak'ahs, even if it is late.
    • Collect pebbles about the size of a chickpea: 49 if you leave Mina on the 12th, 70 if you stay until the 13th. Taking a few extra is wise. They may also be picked up in Mina.
    • Sleep, pray Fajr early, then face the qibla and make du'a until the sky is bright.
    • Leave for Mina before sunrise. Women, the elderly, the weak and those caring for them may leave after midnight.

    فَإِذَا أَفَضْتُم مِّنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عِندَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ

    "When you pour down from Arafat, remember Allah at al-Mash'ar al-Haram" (2:198).

    Stoning Jamrat al-Aqabah

    10 Dhul Hijjah, the Day of Eid al-Adha

    • Only the large jamrah, the one nearest Makkah, is stoned today. Its preferred time is after sunrise.
    • Stop the talbiyah when you begin.
    • Throw seven pebbles one at a time, saying takbir with each. Each pebble must land in the basin; it does not need to hit the pillar.
    • Do not stop for du'a afterwards. If a pebble misses, throw another in its place.
    • Someone who is unable, such as the sick or elderly, may appoint another pilgrim to throw for them after that person has thrown for themselves.

    اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ

    With every pebble.

    Sacrifice and cutting the hair

    10 Dhul Hijjah, after stoning

    • Sacrifice (hady): required for Tamattu' and Qiran. Most pilgrims buy an official voucher, and the animal is slaughtered on their behalf. Wait for confirmation before cutting your hair. If you cannot afford it, fast three days during Hajj and seven at home.
    • Hair: men shave the head (preferred) or shorten the hair evenly; women cut about a fingertip's length from the ends.
    • First release: after stoning and cutting the hair, everything forbidden in ihram becomes permitted again except marital relations. You may change into normal clothes.

    The sunnah order on this day is stoning, sacrifice, hair, then tawaf. The Prophet ﷺ allowed those who did them in a different order, so do not worry if crowds change your plan.

    Tawaf al-Ifadah and sa'i

    In Makkah, from the 10th onwards

    • This tawaf is a pillar of Hajj. It is best done on the 10th but may be delayed to the following days.
    • It is done like the Umrah tawaf, in wudu, seven counterclockwise circuits starting at the Black Stone, but usually in normal clothes, so there is no uncovered shoulder (idtiba) and no brisk walking (ramal).
    • Pray two rak'ahs, drink Zamzam, then perform sa'i: seven laps starting at Safa and ending at Marwah.
    • Qiran and Ifrad pilgrims who did sa'i after their arrival tawaf do not repeat it.
    • After this, the ihram is fully lifted, including marital relations.

    رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ

    Between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone in each circuit.

    The Umrah guide has an animated walkthrough of sa'i. Open it

    The days of Tashreeq

    11, 12 and optionally 13 Dhul Hijjah, in Mina

    • Spend the nights in Mina.
    • Each day after midday (zawal), stone all three jamarat in this order, seven pebbles each with takbir: al-Ula (small), al-Wusta (middle), then al-Aqabah (large).
    • After al-Ula, step aside, face the qibla, raise your hands and make a long du'a. Do the same after al-Wusta. Do not stop after al-Aqabah.
    • You may leave Mina on the 12th if you depart before sunset. Otherwise stay the night and stone again on the 13th.

    فَمَن تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَن تَأَخَّرَ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ لِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ

    "Whoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sin on him, and whoever delays, there is no sin on him, for the one who fears Allah" (2:203).

    The farewell tawaf

    Your last act in Makkah

    • Before leaving Makkah for home, perform seven circuits of tawaf al-Wada'. No sa'i follows it.
    • Make it the last thing you do in Makkah. Buying a few things on the way out is fine, but staying on afterwards means repeating it.
    • Women who are menstruating or have postnatal bleeding are excused from it.
    • If Tawaf al-Ifadah is delayed until departure, one tawaf with that intention can count for both.

    حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ وَذَنْبٌ مَغْفُورٌ

    Your Hajj is complete

    May it be an accepted Hajj, and may your sins be forgiven.
